From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — W-9 and bank letter attached

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these so quickly and for the call earlier. A couple of quick items from our side so we can clear the PO hold: 

1) EIN liveness check: Our finance team runs a verification (internal IRS API handshake plus a quick bank-letter cross-match). The bank letter you included is helpful — can you confirm the letter is dated within the last 90 days and on bank letterhead with an authorizing signature?

2) Signatory authority: The e-signed W-9 lists Maria Santos as signer. For our internal controls we need either: (a) a DocuSign envelope showing Maria was the signer, or (b) a simple signer-authority statement on company letterhead from your CEO/COO confirming Maria's role, or (c) a notarized W-9.

3) Alternative pilot: We're currently piloting an electronic notarization alternative (video-notary proof) for a small set of vendors. If you're open to that, it can speed release by ~48 hours vs sending a physical notary. I can share the vendor-facing instructions.

If you can send one of the signatory artifacts and confirm the bank-letter age, Procurement can release the PO conditionally.

I'll loop Kimberly for procurement release once we have the artifact.

Thanks,
David
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

David — thanks, tagging this for procurement workflow. Quick checklist I need to confirm before I can flip PO to Active: 

• Valid W-9 (name match on remittance profile) — e-signed acceptable if DocuSign envelope or signer-authority present.
• EIN liveness (bank letter within 90 days or IRS CP575/official document).
• Authorized signer evidence (CEO/COO letter OR DocuSign envelope OR notarized W-9).
• Supplier master data completed in Coupa (we'll fill after signatures are confirmed).

If they can complete the DocuSign path, please ask them to use this DocuSign template link: https://docusign.redwood/partner-w9 (one-time use — we track signer metadata). If Elena prefers the video-notary pilot, David — please send the vendor-facing instructions and I'll accept the notarization artifact.

If they can get DocuSigned and re-upload by EOD Wed (11/4), procurement can move PO from HOLD to PENDING PAYMENT the same day.

Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
